description: Block commands that change this Nix-managed machine outside the flake
fallback: Never run darwin-rebuild, nixos-rebuild or home-manager switch directly, or imperative installs and settings changes (brew install, apt/dnf/pacman install, npm install -g, pip install --user, defaults write, gsettings set, systemctl enable, launchctl load). Change the Nix configuration instead and run `switch` to apply it.
